frame: robot frame (mm), X forward, Y left, Z up; parts exported as installed

parts.name: pod_cover_left
parts.notes: left pod cover + wheel fender; rests on lid_left top on 4 screw bosses + 2 pads; 4 x M3 x 10 from above into free lid-grid inserts; cut-outs: mic post, speaker box (+3 mm)

parts.name: pod_cover_right
parts.notes: right pod cover + wheel fender (mirror of left body); 4 x M3 x 10 into free lid-grid inserts + 2 pads; cut-outs: stop button, sensor post, ESP32 USB slot; vent slots over the Pi and in the skirt over the pod wall vents

parts.name: nose_shroud_left
parts.notes: left half of the nose shroud; rests on the nose top (3 pads, VHB tape) and bears on the nose side (2 ribs); 2 x M3 x 16 heads + 2 x 3 mm pins at the centre chin; LiDAR opening +3 mm; front face open below z 125

parts.name: nose_shroud_right
parts.notes: right half of the nose shroud (mirror); 2 x M3 x 5.7 heat-set inserts from the split face + 2 pin holes at the chin; keep the LD2410 window (front face, z < 125) uncovered
